info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Rooms Pricings-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Pricing API provides access to the pricing details of various hotel rooms available for booking. This endpoint allows users to retrieve up-to-date pricing information, enabling them to make informed decisions while planning their accommodations. Typical consumers include travel agencies, tour operators, and consumers looking for competitive pricing during their stay. By using this API, developers can integrate real-time pricing data into their applications, enhancing user experience and improving booking functionality.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the current pricing details for available rooms. It provides a comprehensive view of pricing based on various factors to help with decision-making.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve pricing information for rooms. The body must contain the necessary parameters to specify the type of room or pricing information desired.

200.description: Successful retrieval of room pricing information.
